submission.submission_type.basis: Explicit submission artifact in the edition's registered-design answer: During the testing phase, each participant was allowed to successfully submit the Docker container only once to prevent repeated tuning on the hidden test set. In addition, a strict separation between the validation leaderboard (public) and the final test evaluation (private) was maintained, ensuring that final rankings were determined solely based on the unseen test set. To further safeguard fairness and result integrity, top-ranked submissions underwent manual verification by the organizing co
